solution.text:
The curve is y=x2(x+a)a2 which is a cubic polynomial.

Since x2(x+a)a2=0 has a repeated root x=0,

it touches x-axis at (0, 0) and intersects at (-a, 0) .



Hence, required area =∫-a0y dx=∫-a0x2x+aa2dx=1a2x44+ax33-a0

=a212 sq. units
